abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) systems require optimal performance of both quantum and classical channels\textemdash utilizing as few as possible qubits and bits for establishing as many as possible key bits. Here we report a way to determine if a quantum key distribution model (or protocol) operates in an optimal behavior.
